plugin.title: ZXTune - Chiptune, Tracker & Video Game Music Player
ZXTune - Lettore Chiptune, Tracker e Musica per Videogiochi
plugin.desc: Full port of ZXTune (r5112) for Daphile / Lyrion Music Server. Plays 120+ chiptune, tracker, and videogame music formats (ZX Spectrum AY/YM, C64 SID, NES NSF/NSFE, SNES SPC/RSN, GameBoy GBS, Genesis/Master System VGM/VGZ, PC Engine HES, MSX KSS, Atari SAP, PlayStation PSF/USF/GSF/2SF/SSF/DSF, Amiga MOD/XM/IT/S3M/AHX/HVL, archives .zip/.7z/.rar/.lha/.trd/.scl), streams Random Radio, and browses 14 online catalogues (ModArchive, ModLand, HVSC, ASMA, VGMRips, Khinsider, OCReMix, JoshW, ZX-Art, ZXTunes, AMP, Aminet, Scene.org, AYGOR).

Port completo di ZXTune (r5112) per Daphile / Lyrion Music Server. Riproduce oltre 120 formati chiptune, tracker e musica per videogiochi, archivi multi-traccia, radio casuale e 14 cataloghi online (ModArchive, ModLand, HVSC, ASMA, VGMRips, Khinsider, OCReMix, JoshW, ZX-Art, ZXTunes, AMP, Aminet, Scene.org, AYGOR).
